```artifact
Feature: Alarms in GUI

  Scenario: Compute VTE for each breath
    Given the GUI is initialized
    When the VTE for the current breath is set to 10
    Then the GUI should compute the VTE for the current breath as 10

  Scenario: Compute "HIGH VTE" alarm
    Given the GUI is initialized
    And the VTE threshold for HIGH VTE alarm is set to 10
    When the VTE for the current breath is set to 15
    Then the GUI should compute a "HIGH VTE" alarm
    And the alarm should be of medium priority

  Scenario: Compute "LOW VTE" alarm
    Given the GUI is initialized
    And the VTE threshold for LOW VTE alarm is set to 5
    When the VTE for the current breath is set to 3
    Then the GUI should compute a "LOW VTE" alarm
    And the alarm should be of medium priority

  Scenario: "HIGH VTE" alarm at threshold
    Given the GUI is initialized
    And the VTE threshold for HIGH VTE alarm is set to 10
    When the VTE for the current breath is set to 10
    Then the GUI should compute a "HIGH VTE" alarm
    And the alarm should be of medium priority

  Scenario: "HIGH VTE" alarm just below threshold
    Given the GUI is initialized
    And the VTE threshold for HIGH VTE alarm is set to 10
    When the VTE for the current breath is set to 9
    Then the GUI should not compute a "HIGH VTE" alarm

  Scenario: "HIGH VTE" alarm just above threshold
    Given the GUI is initialized
    And the VTE threshold for HIGH VTE alarm is set to 10
    When the VTE for the current breath is set to 11
    Then the GUI should compute a "HIGH VTE" alarm
    And the alarm should be of medium priority

  Scenario: "LOW VTE" alarm at threshold
    Given the GUI is initialized
    And the VTE threshold for LOW VTE alarm is set to 5
    When the VTE for the current breath is set to 5
    Then the GUI should compute a "LOW VTE" alarm
    And the alarm should be of medium priority

  Scenario: "LOW VTE" alarm just below threshold
    Given the GUI is initialized
    And the VTE threshold for LOW VTE alarm is set to 5
    When the VTE for the current breath is set to 4
    Then the GUI should not compute a "LOW VTE" alarm

  Scenario: "LOW VTE" alarm just above threshold
    Given the GUI is initialized
    And the VTE threshold for LOW VTE alarm is set to 5
    When the VTE for the current breath is set to 6
    Then the GUI should compute a "LOW VTE" alarm
    And the alarm should be of medium priority

  Scenario: High-priority alarm for O2 input line disconnection
    Given the GUI is initialized
    When the O2 input line is disconnected
    Then the GUI should compute a high-priority alarm
    And the alarm should be triggered

  Scenario: Display all currently active alarms
    Given the GUI is initialized
    And there are multiple active alarms
    When the user requests to display all active alarms
    Then the GUI should display all currently active alarms

  Scenario: Event log includes all confirmed alarm settings
    Given the GUI is initialized
    And an alarm is confirmed
    When the event log is checked
    Then the event log should include the confirmed alarm settings with timestamps and alarm IDs
```
